APPROVE
The three extracted helpers (`TryList`, `ReadWanted`, `EnqueueReal`) keep the same order of operations, the same exception filters and `unread` entries, and the same early break at `maxFiles`; this leaves `Files` well under 15, the CHA0004 suppression still covers every catch now in the helpers, and the `out` parameters are assigned on every path so it should compile cleanly (I checked this from the diff alone and did not build the project or confirm the parameter types against the full file).
